kit_meta.title: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' GEX (v3.1)
kit_meta.provenance: SCAFFOLD ONLY. This captures the correct workflow stages, checkpoints, decision points, and troubleshooting for the 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' v3.1 assay. All volumes, incubation times, and PCR cycle numbers are marked '[confirm with source protocol]' and MUST be taken from the official 10x User Guide (e.g., CG000315). Do not run from this scaffold alone.

protocol_title: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' GEX (v3.1) — reference protocol
objective: Generate barcoded 3' gene-expression sequencing libraries from a single-cell suspension.
summary: Reference SCAFFOLD for the multi-stage 10x 3' GEX workflow. Stage order, QC gates, and decision points are correct; quantitative parameters are intentionally left to confirm from the official user guide.

sample_requirements: Viable single-cell suspension (target viability and cell concentration per guide)
reagent_requirements: Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' Kit v3.1 reagents (Gel Beads, Master Mix, Partitioning Oil)
safety_notes: Maintain cold chain and RNase-free technique throughout.
Follow 10x chip-loading and emulsion-handling instructions exactly to avoid wetting failures.
lab_specific_fields_to_confirm: Confirm target cell recovery and loading concentration
Confirm all reagent volumes from the user guide
Confirm cDNA and library PCR cycle numbers

materials.item: Dual Index Plate TT Set A

workflow.title: Prepare & QC single-cell suspension
instructions: Prepare a single-cell suspension in the recommended buffer.
Count cells and assess viability; target the loading concentration in the user guide.
workflow.checkpoint: Viability and concentration meet guide targets.
human_review_required: Sample-handling step — viability/concentration drive the entire run.

actions: Optimize dissociation; dead-cell removal; work quickly/cold

workflow.title: GEM generation & barcoding
instructions: Prepare the RT Master Mix and load Master Mix + cells, Gel Beads, and Partitioning Oil into the chip wells (volumes [confirm with source protocol]).
Run the chip on the Chromium instrument to generate GEMs.
workflow.expected_observation: Uniform, opaque GEM emulsion; no wetting failure.
human_review_required: Sample-handling step — confirm all chip-loading volumes from the guide.

actions: Filter cells; load carefully; follow guide

workflow.title: Post-GEM RT incubation
instructions: Incubate the GEMs in a thermal cycler per the guide (program [confirm with source protocol]).

workflow.title: Post-GEM cleanup (Silane/Dynabeads)
instructions: Break the emulsion and clean up cDNA using Silane/Dynabeads and SPRIselect per guide (volumes [confirm with source protocol]).

workflow.title: cDNA amplification & QC
workflow.purpose: Amplify cDNA; check quality before library prep.
instructions: Amplify cDNA by PCR (cycle number [confirm with source protocol], based on input cells).
Clean up with SPRIselect; QC cDNA on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation and quantify.

conditions.other: PCR cycles depend on input — confirm

workflow.expected_observation: cDNA trace with expected size distribution.
human_review_required: Confirm cDNA PCR cycle number for your cell input.

actions: Increase cycles within guide range; improve input

workflow.title: 3' GEX library construction
instructions: Fragment, end-repair, A-tail, and ligate adaptors ([confirm with source protocol]).
Perform sample index PCR with the dual index plate (cycle number [confirm with source protocol]).
human_review_required: Confirm library PCR cycle number and size-selection ratios.

workflow.title: Library QC & sequencing setup
instructions: Quantify the library (qPCR/Qubit) and check size (Bioanalyzer/TapeStation).
Pool and sequence with the read configuration from the guide ([confirm with source protocol]).
workflow.checkpoint: Library passes QC; sequencing parameters set.

qc_checkpoints.recommended_action_on_fail: Adjust PCR cycles / input; do not proceed if failing.

pass_criteria: Correct size; quantifiable; minimal adapter dimer

options: Higher load (more cells, more multiplets) — per guide table

failure_branches.condition: Low cell recovery / high multiplet rate
recommended_modifications: Recount; adjust loading per guide; improve viability
